channel.title: The Rising Nepal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Rising Nepal (risingnepaldaily.com)

item.title: Seven killed in separate road accidents in various districts
item.description: According to police, one person died in an accident at Dhaka Border, Malangwa Municipality-4 on Monday night; another person died when a tanker hit a scooter at Nipani Chowk, Ratnanagar Municipality-1, Chitwan; and one person died when a vehicle carrying a mixer machine hit a scooter in Chumlingtar, Ichchhakamana Rural Municipality-3, Chitwan.

item.title: 3,500 projects proposed for equalization and special grants
item.description: According to the National Planning Commission (NPC), local levels have proposed 3,358 projects and programmes and the provinces 140 projects and programmes for this purpose.

item.title: Mamata Mridul awarded with honorary doctorate
item.description: The Mahabir Prasad Hindi University and Research Corporation, Raebareli, awarded Mridul with the doctorate title at the Nepal-India Literary Conference held recently in Varanasi, India.

item.title: Sanitation Study Centre established in Lumbini
item.description: A sanitation study centre has been established for waste management in Buddha's birthplace, Lumbini.

item.title: Bird Flu in Jhapa: Transportation of poultry products banned
item.description: The District Administration Office, Jhapa has issued a public notice calling for adopting high precautions following the confirmation of Bird Flu infection in chickens of commercially operated poultry farms in Damak Municipality and Jhapa Rural Municipality.

item.title: NC to hold 15th general convention from Bhadra 24 (Sept 9, 2026)
item.description: Nepali Congress President Gagan Kumar Thapa has presented a proposal of holding the party's 15th general convention from Bhadra 24 (September 9) to Bhadra 26 (September 11) in the central committee.

item.title: Election Commission to dispose of unused ballot papers
item.description: The Election Commission (EC) is planning to dispose of the unused ballot papers after the completion of House of Representatives election held on March 5.

item.title: Clash in Bardiya: Police makes 10 rounds of blank fire
item.description: Pramesh Bista, DSP at the district police office, Bardiya, said the police resorted to blank fires to bring the situation under control as the people started pelting stone at the police.

item.title: Writ petition related to RSP President to be heard on Thursday
item.description: Hearing on the writ petition filed at the Supreme Court against the decision to withdraw offenses related to organized crime and money laundering against Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) President Rabi Lamichhane will continue on Thursday.

item.title: NC faces difficulty for forgetting agenda: President Thapa
item.description: Nepali Congress President Gagan Kumar Thapa has said the NC met the present fate after it forgot its agenda. NC, established for freedom and equality, must not forget its agenda of keeping people in centre, he stressed.

item.title: KU ranked 122nd in HE Higher Education Ranking
item.description: The Kathmandu University (KU) of Nepal has been ranked 122nd among 507 universities from 95 countries in the 'HE Higher Education Ranking' conducted by a USA-based organization.

item.title: Prime Minister Cup Cricket: Bagmati beats Gandaki by 170 runs
item.description: The team was bowled out for 124 runs in 31.5 overs. Arjun Kumal became the top scorer for his team with 74 runs but lacked support from the rest of the batting lineup.

item.title: Rainfall experienced in different districts including Kathmandu
item.description: Rainfall took place in some districts including Kathmandu of the country today, as a result of the partial effect of westerly winds and local winds.
